$comment: Golden cases for the two ICU renderers: IcuMessageFormatter (daemon) and intl-messageformat on build-time compiled messages (desktop). Both test suites render every entry and must produce exactly `expected`. Every code in i18n/en/errors.json needs an entry with example params.

app.permission.denied.expected: The app is not allowed to do this (notifications).

app.storage.too_large.expected: The app tried to store more than it may keep. The limit is 64 KB.

auth.challenge.expired.expected: The sign-in step has expired. Please sign in again.

auth.credentials.invalid.expected: The user name or password is incorrect.

auth.csrf.header_missing.expected: The request was rejected because a security header is missing.

auth.display_name.invalid.expected: The display name can have at most 64 characters and no control characters.

auth.password.too_common.expected: This password is one of the most commonly used passwords. Choose one that is harder to guess.

auth.password.too_long.expected: The password can have at most 1024 characters.

auth.password.too_short.expected: The password needs at least 12 characters.

auth.permission.denied.expected: You do not have permission for this action.

auth.rate.limited.expected: Too many attempts. Try again in 1 second.

auth.recovery.invalid.expected: The user name or recovery key is incorrect.

auth.session.expired.expected: The session has expired. Please sign in again.

auth.setup.already_done.expected: This system has already been set up.

auth.totp.invalid.expected: The code is incorrect or has already been used.

auth.totp.not_enrolled.expected: Two-factor authentication has not been set up yet.

auth.username.invalid.expected: User names start with a lowercase letter or an underscore and contain only lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, at most 32 characters.

auth.username.reserved.expected: The user name root is reserved for the system.

desktop.device.not_found.expected: No saved desktop was found for that device. It may have expired.

desktop.item.conflict.expected: This desktop item was changed on another device in the meantime.

desktop.item.invalid.expected: The desktop item could not be saved because it is not in a known format.

desktop.item.limit_reached.expected: The desktop is full. It holds at most 200 items.

desktop.item.not_found.expected: This desktop item no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.

desktop.layout.conflict.expected: The desktop layout was saved from another tab in the meantime.

desktop.layout.invalid.expected: The desktop layout could not be saved because it is not in a known format.

desktop.layout.too_large.expected: The desktop layout is too large to save. At most 50 windows and 16 KB of app data are kept.

desktop.note.too_long.expected: The note is too long. A note holds at most 4000 characters.

fs.cursor.invalid.expected: The list position is no longer valid. Load the folder again.

fs.entry.access_denied.expected: The system does not allow access to this item.

fs.entry.is_folder.expected: This is a folder, not a file.

fs.entry.not_folder.expected: This is a file, not a folder.

fs.entry.not_found.expected: The file or folder was not found. It may have been moved or deleted.

fs.io.failed.expected: The file system reported an error (errno 5).

fs.name.invalid.expected: This name cannot be used. Names must not be empty, contain a slash, or be longer than 255 bytes.

fs.operation.into_itself.expected: A folder cannot be copied or moved into itself.

fs.operation.invalid.expected: This file operation is not valid.

fs.path.invalid.expected: This path is not valid. Paths are relative to the share, without “.” or “..”, and at most 999 bytes long.

fs.range.not_satisfiable.expected: The requested part of the file does not exist.

fs.share.exists.expected: A share with this name already exists.

fs.share.invalid.expected: The share could not be created. It needs a name and an existing folder outside the system directories.

fs.share.not_found.expected: The share was not found, or you have no access to it.

fs.share.read_only.expected: You can only read in this share.

fs.trash.retention_invalid.expected: The recycle bin keeps items between 0 and 999 days (0 keeps them until it is emptied).

fs.upload.incomplete.expected: The upload was interrupted. Nothing was saved.

fs.version.not_found.expected: This version is no longer there. The snapshot may have been deleted; reload the list.

fs.volume.full.expected: There is not enough free space.

jobs.job.not_found.expected: This job does not exist or has already been removed.

realtime.message.invalid.expected: The live connection received a message it does not understand.

realtime.topic.invalid.expected: storage/#/x is not a valid topic name or pattern.

realtime.topic.unknown.expected: There is no live data topic named storage/nothing.

realtime.upgrade.required.expected: This address only accepts WebSocket connections.

request.media_type.unsupported.expected: The request uses a content type the server does not accept.

request.method.not_allowed.expected: This API endpoint does not support the request method.

request.route.not_found.expected: This API endpoint does not exist.

sdk.method.unknown.expected: This version of Pithyx does not support what the app asked for (storage.get).

sdk.protocol.unsupported.expected: This app needs another version of Pithyx (protocol 3, supported 1 to 2).

sdk.request.invalid.expected: The app sent a request the desktop cannot process (notify).

sdk.request.timeout.expected: The desktop did not answer the app in time (notify).

sdk.transport.closed.expected: The connection between the app and the desktop is closed. Open the app again.

storage.alert.not_found.expected: This alert is no longer active. Its cause is gone.

storage.command.failed.expected: The storage command zpool failed (exit code 1). Nothing after it was run; the log has the details.

storage.dataset.compression_invalid.expected: Pithyx does not set the compression brotli. Choose off, lz4, zle, zstd (levels 1 to 19) or gzip (levels 1 to 9).

storage.dataset.exists.expected: A dataset named media exists already.

storage.dataset.in_use_by_share.expected: The share Media has its folder in tank/pithyx/shares/media. Delete the share on the shared folders page first; there you choose what happens to its data.

storage.dataset.limit_invalid.expected: The quota cannot be negative. Use 0 for none.

storage.dataset.managed.expected: Pithyx finds tank/pithyx/homes/anna by its name (a home folder, an app or system data), so it cannot be renamed or deleted here.

storage.dataset.name_invalid.expected: Dataset names use letters, digits, ., - and _, start with a letter or digit and have up to 64 characters.

storage.dataset.name_mismatch.expected: Type the full dataset name tank/pithyx/shares/media exactly to confirm.

storage.dataset.not_found.expected: There is no dataset named tank/pithyx/shares/media. Reload the page.

storage.dataset.property_unsupported.expected: tank/pithyx/volumes/vm1 does not take the setting recordsize. Volumes take only compression, record size is for file systems only, and the datasets of the Pithyx layout take only compression.

storage.dataset.protected.expected: tank/pithyx/shares is the pool root or part of the Pithyx layout. Pithyx does not rename, delete or limit it.

storage.dataset.quota_below_used.expected: The quota must be at least the space the dataset uses now, snapshots and child datasets included.

storage.dataset.record_size_invalid.expected: The record size must be a power of two from 4 KiB to 1 MiB.

storage.dataset.reservation_too_large.expected: The pool cannot reserve that much for this dataset now. Choose a smaller reservation.

storage.dataset.unchanged.expected: Nothing to change: tank/pithyx/shares/media has these settings already.

storage.disk.not_found.expected: The disk is no longer there. Reload the list and choose again.

storage.disk.refused.expected: The disk may not be used: it belongs to a pool.

storage.encryption.unavailable.expected: Encryption comes with the key vault in the next update. A pool can only be encrypted when it is created, so create it without encryption only if that is fine for its data.

storage.plan.expired.expected: This plan is more than 10 minutes old. Show it again to check the disks once more.

storage.plan.not_found.expected: This plan is no longer there (it ran already, expired or the daemon restarted). Show it again.

storage.plan.stale.expected: A disk changed after the plan was shown. Nothing was changed; show the plan again.

storage.pool.disk_count.expected: raidz2 needs at least 4 disks; 3 are selected.

storage.pool.encryption_required.expected: Answer the encryption question first: it can only be decided when the pool is created.

storage.pool.name_invalid.expected: Pool names start with a lowercase letter and use up to 32 lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Names like mirror or raidz are reserved.

storage.pool.name_mismatch.expected: Type the pool name tank exactly to confirm.

storage.pool.name_taken.expected: A pool named tank exists already.

storage.pool.not_found.expected: There is no pool named tank.

storage.pool.not_prepared.expected: Pithyx did not set up the pool tank (it has no pithyx dataset), so it creates nothing on it.

storage.schedule.invalid.expected: This schedule cannot be set. Choose Off, Weekly or Monthly for an existing pool.

storage.scrub.not_running.expected: Pool tank is not being scrubbed right now.

storage.scrub.running.expected: Pool tank is being scrubbed already.

storage.snapshot.confirmation_mismatch.expected: The name you typed does not match the dataset. Nothing was rolled back.

storage.snapshot.dataset_not_found.expected: There is no dataset named tank/data. Reload the page.

storage.snapshot.exists.expected: A snapshot named pithyx-manual-20260927T210000Z exists already. Wait a second and try again.

storage.snapshot.held.expected: The snapshot pithyx-daily-20260927T000000Z is held and cannot be deleted. Release the hold first.

storage.snapshot.newer_exist.expected: Rolling back would also delete 2 newer snapshots. Review the list and confirm them all.

storage.snapshot.not_found.expected: There is no snapshot named nightly. Reload the list.

storage.snapshot.not_pithyx.expected: Pithyx deletes only snapshots it took. before-upgrade was made by someone else and stays.

storage.snapshot.schedule_invalid.expected: Each schedule is hourly, daily, weekly or monthly, once, and keeps between 1 and 1000 snapshots.

storage.vdev.not_found.expected: The pool has no such device (any more). Reload and choose again.

storage.volume.size_invalid.expected: A volume needs a size of at least 1 MiB.

storage.volume.too_large.expected: The volume does not fit the free space of the pool. Make it smaller or create it as a sparse volume.

system.internal.unexpected.expected: Something went wrong on the server. The request id helps to find the details in the logs.

system.origin.forbidden.expected: The request came from another website and was rejected.
